hints.title: Dedicated Even and Odd Index Heads
hints.text: Maintain an even pointer stepping by two and an odd pointer stepping by two.

hints.title: Misplaced Element Detection
hints.text: Advance the even pointer while values at even indices are even, and advance the odd pointer while values at odd indices are odd.

hints.title: Cross Parity Swapping
hints.text: When both pointers encounter mismatched parities, swap their elements and advance both index pointers by two.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: In-place two-pointer traversal swapping mismatched parity indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate even and odd lists incur extra linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two pointers stepping by two to sort in place.
